observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor grassy field with hills under an overcast sky at sunset
observation.dancers: mixed group of young women dancing and young men seated playing percussion
observation.formation_and_space: line formation of women balancing pots on their heads, transitioning to a circle and kneeling around a central stack of pots
observation.posture: upright torso with balanced posture while carrying pots; kneeling with upright posture
observation.footwork: steady stepping in time with the beat while balancing pots; kneeling movement when close to the ground
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held out or framing the head to balance or adjust pots on the head
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal torso movement to keep pots balanced; gentle bends when kneeling
observation.levels_jumps_turns: standing and kneeling levels; gentle turns while traveling in a circle
observation.costume_and_props: women wear patterned wrap skirts, beaded jewelry, and black clay pots balanced on red head cushions; men wear red patterned tunics and red headbands with feathers; one male dancer waves a patterned red cloth
observation.cannot_infer: exact footwork details are obscured by long skirts and low camera angles

signature_moments.what: Women walk in a line with black pots balanced on their heads while keeping arms delicately raised.
Dancers kneel on the grass in a circle around stacked pots, extending their hands forward.
Dancers rise and step in a circle while maintaining pots on their heads.
